assumption: Re-layout and painting stay smooth for 200 KB+ documents.
evidence: Painting is culled and text shaped once, but a full re-layout of the 206 KB spec takes 150-230 ms, so resizes defer it until the width settles. Blog posts (INT-001) are far smaller, so the common case is fast.
test_method: Timing test on corpus/spec.md; incremental or off-thread layout if resize lag is noticed in use.
